subject: SKU mix & temporary reservation approval request — Skylark Health
messages:
From: Elena Morozova <elena@skylarkhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@skylarkhealth.com>, David Chen <david.chen@skylarkhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary reserve + H100 capacity for Q4 peak

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Skylark's engineering team is excited about Redwood's latency and cost profile. We're planning a big Q4 push: forecast attached. Two asks so we can finalize internal approvals: 

1) Temporary reservation for a 6‑week window (Nov 15 - Dec 31) to cover peak inference demand.
2) Preference for an H100‑class SKU for the reserved pool for the first 3 weeks of the window, then a mixed H100/A100 configuration afterwards.

We're sensitive to both budget and reliability. Can Redwood:
- Hold the reservation without billing the full monthly commit until we confirm production traffic (reservation hold option)?
- Offer a clear overage rate for burst beyond the reservation?
- Provide a short addendum to the SLA for the peak window?

I've attached the demand forecast (Skylark_Demand_Forecast_Q4.xlsx). Procurement is on this thread to coordinate PO timing.

Best,
Elena Morozova
Director of ML Infrastructure
Skylark Health

Attachments: Skylark_Demand_Forecast_Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morozova <elena@skylarkhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary reserve + H100 capacity for Q4 peak

Elena — thanks for the forecast and the clarity. Short answer: we can support the request but need an exception approved for (a) H100‑first SKU mix and (b) the reservation hold / delayed billing for the commit window.

Proposed commercial terms (initial ask):
- 6‑week temporary reservation: Nov 15 – Dec 31
- Commit: 80 reserved units equivalent (H100‑pricing baseline) with auto‑downgrade to mixed SKU as traffic normalizes
- Reservation hold: Redwood will place the reservation and hold billing for up to 21 days after reservation start if Skylark elects to confirm production (we will not bill beyond the initial free hold period unless Skylark confirms).
- Overage: 1.8x per‑token overage for burst beyond reservation; if H100 is used, overage on H100 is 2.1x baseline for ad hoc extra capacity.
- One‑time SLA addendum for the peak window (we can draft; will need legal sign).

To move forward I need an approvals path for the SKU exception (H100 mix) and the reservation hold. Laura / Lauren — can you confirm the allowed discount/term exceptions and whether deals desk can sign off on the proposed overage cap and hold? I will prepare the draft SLA addendum and a revised quote.

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0183

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary reserve + H100 capacity for Q4 peak

Sean — thanks for the clear summary. I'm looping in Marissa (Deals Desk ops) and Lauren (Sales Ops / approvals). My initial read: we can approve a temporary H100‑heavy reservation with conditions. Conditions I want documented in the amendment: 

- Discount/credits: No additional list price discount on H100 SKUs beyond standard tiered pricing; we can authorize up to a one‑time onboarding credit (capped at $25k) if procurement signs PO within 14 days of the quote.
- Reservation hold: Approve a hold of up to 21 days as proposed. After hold expiry, reservation billing will begin retroactively to the reserved period start unless Skylark confirms cancellation.
- Overage rate cap: Approve a maximum overage multiplier of 2.0x on H100 for the peak window (reduces Sean's proposed 2.1x). Non‑H100 overage stays at 1.8x.
- SLA addendum: Legal must approve; deals desk can accept operational SLAs but not change core indemnities. Please send Draft_SLA_Amendment.docx for review.

Please update the quote to reflect the onboarding credit line item and the overage cap. Marissa — are there any quota or capacity constraints for the requested Nov 15 start?

Laura
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Elena Morozova <elena@skylarkhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary reserve + H100 capacity for Q4 peak

Thanks all — final decision and approvals below. Forwarding the items required to complete contracting.

Approved (conditions):
- Temporary reservation (Nov 15 – Dec 31) approved with H100‑first allocation for the first 3 weeks, then mixed SKU as described.
- Reservation hold of up to 21 days approved. If Skylark confirms production during hold, billing will begin prospectively from the confirmation date; if hold expires without confirmation, we bill retroactively to reservation start (per Laura's condition).
- Overage: capped at 2.0x for H100, 1.8x for non‑H100.
- One‑time onboarding credit: approved, capped at $25,000, payable after PO acceptance.

Next steps (action items):
1) Sean — upload Draft_SLA_Amendment.docx to legal@redwood.com and include the PO timeline.
2) Sean — update the quote in HubSpot and send a DocuSign link to Skylark (deal id RDW-DEAL-2027-8342).
3) Marissa — confirm capacity availability and reserve tentative H100 pool; mark the reservation as pending until PO received.
4) Skylark Procurement (Elena / David) — please confirm PO timing; once PO is in we will finalize the addendum and start allocation.

Elena — I added a DocuSign link for the SLA addendum draft: https://www.docusign.com/sign?docId=RDW-SLA-8342. Laura and Marissa, loop Legal on any material SLA changes; otherwise this is approved and we can proceed.

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
Director, Deal Desk — Redwood Inference
